first-report
首次使用
Your first report
先用一份材料完成自己的第一稿。
Create a first draft from one source.
安装桌面版并打开一个独立工作区。工作区保存材料、稿件、对话和运行记录。
在设置中选择已安装并完成认证的宿主与模型。先确认材料允许发送给该服务。
新建报告，写清读者、日期范围、需要回答的问题及目标篇幅；加入一份公开材料。
启动生成，在任务对话查看实际进度。保存后打开正文、检查引用，再尝试编辑并保存。
从导出菜单生成 Word；完成后下载并用 Word 或 WPS 打开。
Install the desktop app and open a separate workspace for sources, drafts, conversations and task records.
In settings, select an installed, authenticated runtime and model. Confirm that your source may be sent to that service.
Create a report. Specify the audience, date range, questions and target length, then add one public source.
Start generation and follow progress in its task conversation. Open the saved draft, check citations, edit and save.
Generate Word from the export menu. Download the completed file and open it in Word or WPS.
成功时能看到已保存的稿件版本和可打开的 Word 文件。排队、开始生成或出现下载按钮本身都不代表文件已完成。
Success means a saved draft version and a Word file you can open. A queued task or download button alone is not proof of completion.
没有模型账号时先阅读网站的使用说明；若所装版本提供“先看合成示例”，可离线体验编辑和导出，但它不是实际模型生成或独立审阅的报告。

Without a model account, read these guides first. If your installed version offers a synthetic sample, it can demonstrate editing and export without a model; it is not an independently reviewed, model-generated report.
install-update
安装与更新
Install and update
选对安装包，保留工作区后更新。
Choose the right installer and preserve your workspace.
从下载页选择 Apple 芯片 Mac 的 DMG 或 Windows x64 的 EXE。Mac 芯片在“关于本机”查看；不要依据浏览器中的 Intel 字样判断。
准备 Python 3.11 或更高版本。已有兼容的 3.12 可以使用，App 不强制下载 3.11，也不自动安装系统 Python。
Mac 将 App 拷入 Applications；Windows 运行安装程序。首次打开按提示准备应用专属依赖环境。
模型 CLI 需另外安装并认证。桌面桥接复用 Electron 内置 Node；WebUI 的桥接宿主另需 Node.js 20+。
更新前保存稿件，并在任务空闲时备份整个工作区。设置中检查更新；Mac 下载后在 Finder 替换 App，Windows 使用安装程序。
Choose the Apple silicon DMG or Windows x64 EXE on the download page. Check About This Mac for the chip; browser Intel labels are unreliable.
Prepare Python 3.11 or later. A compatible existing 3.12 installation is supported; the app neither requires a new 3.11 download nor installs system Python automatically.
On Mac, copy the app to Applications. On Windows, run the installer. Follow the first-launch steps to prepare app-specific dependencies.
Install and authenticate a model CLI separately. Desktop bridges use Electron’s built-in Node; WebUI bridge runtimes need Node.js 20+.
Save drafts and back up the entire workspace while tasks are idle. Check updates in settings. On Mac, replace the app in Finder; Windows uses its installer.
重新打开 App 后核对版本，再打开原工作区确认原稿与材料仍在。PyPI 包提供服务与 WebUI，不包含桌面 App。
After restarting, check the app version and open the original workspace to confirm drafts and sources. The PyPI package provides the service and WebUI, not the desktop app.
首批 Mac 与 Windows 包均未签名，Mac 也未公证。核对官方来源与 SHA256 后使用系统的单应用许可入口，不要关闭整体安全防护。更新请求失败可从官方 Releases 获取安装包；不要删除工作区来修复下载错误。

Initial Mac and Windows packages are unsigned; Mac packages are also not notarized. Verify the official source and SHA256, then use the OS permission for that app rather than disabling system protection. If updates fail, use official Releases; do not delete the workspace to fix a download.
models-costs
接入模型与费用
Models and costs
知道谁执行任务、谁接收内容、谁计费。
Understand execution, data recipients and billing.
宿主是本机执行工具，模型是它连接的生成服务。先在宿主中完成登录或 API 配置，再在 BriefLoop 设置中选择。
使用宿主实际支持的模型 ID。保存配置不等于连接测试成功；用一小段公开文字进行首次对话验证。
主链、Evaluator、Wiki Maintainer 与 Skill Proposer 可分别指定模型。留空继承主链时，学习和评价同样可能调用模型。
为报告设置检索量、篇幅和执行时限。这些控制不等同于完整费用上限，宿主自带搜索的计量能力也不同。
在模型与搜索提供方后台核对实际额度及账单。BriefLoop 不提供这些服务的订阅或模型额度。
A runtime is the local execution tool; a model is the generation service it connects to. Authenticate or configure its API first, then select it in BriefLoop.
Use a model ID supported by that runtime. Saving settings is not a successful connection test; validate with a short public-text conversation.
The main agent, Evaluator, Wiki Maintainer and Skill Proposer can use separate models. Evaluation and learning may also consume model usage.
Set research limits, length and execution time. These are not a complete monetary cap; metering of runtime-native search varies.
Check actual quotas and bills with the model and search providers. BriefLoop does not supply their subscriptions or model credits.
首次对话应有实际回复。后续新任务使用保存的配置，正在运行或已排队的任务保留原配置。
The first conversation should return an actual response. New tasks use saved settings; queued and running tasks retain their original configuration.
额度不足、429、503 或模型不存在时，先查看任务错误及宿主登录状态。不要只因为模型名字相同就假设订阅互通。只读权限和联网控制依宿主能力而异。

For quota errors, 429, 503 or an unknown model, inspect the task error and runtime authentication. Matching model names do not imply shared subscriptions. Read-only and network controls vary by runtime.
write-edit
制作和修改报告
Write and edit reports
从材料、要求到可持续修改的正文。
Move from sources and requirements to an editable draft.
新建报告，明确读者、用途、期间与必须回答的问题。历史财报与当月动态应分别标注期间。
加入原始材料；搜索摘要仅作为发现线索。核对来源的日期、主体和口径。
生成后先阅读结论与表格，再检查关键引用。低分或审阅未通过的工作稿仍可查看和下载。
在正文编辑后保存，或把具体修改要求发给 BriefLoop。保留原稿，确认修改形成新版本。
保存后生成 Word。导出固定点击时的已保存版本，之后的修改需要再次导出。
Create a report with its audience, purpose, period and required questions. Distinguish historical financial periods from current-month events.
Add original sources; use search snippets only as discovery leads. Check dates, entities and definitions.
Read conclusions and tables, then inspect key citations. Working drafts remain visible and downloadable even with low scores or unresolved review issues.
Edit and save the body, or give BriefLoop specific revision instructions. Preserve the original and confirm that changes create a new version.
Generate Word after saving. Export uses the saved version fixed when requested; later edits require another export.
正文、版本记录与导出的内容应对应。网页用于编辑，最终分页在 Word/WPS 中核对。
The body, version history and exported content should correspond. Edit in the browser and check final pagination in Word or WPS.
如果生成失败，先检查任务日志和已保存产物，再按实际错误恢复。不要重复提交同一报告来代替恢复；未保存的编辑也不会自动进入旧导出。
If generation fails, inspect task logs and saved artifacts before recovering. Do not submit duplicate reports as a substitute for recovery. Unsaved edits do not appear in an earlier export.
evidence-review
看依据与处理问题
Sources and review
区分已保存、已关联、已评分与已核查。
Distinguish saved, linked, scored and reviewed content.
点击正文引用，查看来源标题、日期和摘录，并在必要时打开原件核对。
对重要数字核对主体、期间、单位、分母和计算。来源有冲突时保留差异，不把二手摘要当作解决依据。
读取当前版本的评分及具体问题；旧稿评分不能自动用于改写后的稿件。
如所用版本提供独立审阅，查看其实际范围与未核验项目。宿主缺少只读隔离能力时，不能只凭提示词声称隔离成立。
把问题交回 BriefLoop 修订或人工修正并保存，再对新版本核查。普通工作稿下载与正式交付资格分开。
Open citations to inspect the source title, date and excerpt, and consult originals where needed.
For important figures, check entity, period, units, denominators and calculations. Preserve source conflicts rather than resolving them with a secondary summary.
Read scores and specific findings for the current version; an old score does not automatically apply to a rewritten draft.
If your version supports independent review, inspect its actual scope and unchecked items. A prompt alone cannot provide read-only isolation when the runtime lacks it.
Ask BriefLoop to revise findings, or edit and save yourself, then check the new version. Downloading a working draft is separate from eligibility for formal delivery.
每个已处理问题应能在新版本中定位到修改，核查范围与未决问题仍清楚可见。来源链接或关联记录本身不是事实证明。
Each resolved issue should correspond to a change in the new version, with review scope and unresolved issues visible. A source link or binding alone is not factual proof.
扫描 PDF、图片和缺少缓存的 Excel 公式可能需要额外核对。存在确定重大错误、核心证据缺口或未决重要冲突时，不应把稿件称为正式可交付。

Scanned PDFs, images and Excel formulas without cached values may need additional checks. Do not call a draft formally deliverable while it contains material errors, core evidence gaps or unresolved material conflicts.
templates-charts
模板与图表
Templates and charts
分别管理内容方法、版式和图表数据。
Manage writing methods, layout and chart data separately.
先写清报告用途和内容要求，再选择可用的 Word 版式。版式名称不证明对应领域已有专门研究流程。
需要企业模板时上传 DOCX，检查识别出的章节与待填写项；支持范围以当前安装版本为准。
编辑表格后核对单位、行列和汇总关系。图表应保留来源与数据期间。
让 BriefLoop 修改复杂图表时，要求核对关联数据；不要只按图片外观确认数值正确。
保存后导出并在 Word/WPS 中查看字体、分页、表格宽度和图注。
Specify the report purpose and content before choosing a Word layout. A template name does not establish a specialized research workflow.
Upload a DOCX for a company template and inspect recognized sections and manual fields. Supported layouts depend on the installed version.
After table edits, check units, rows, columns and totals. Charts should retain sources and data periods.
When asking BriefLoop to change complex charts, request checks against linked data; appearance alone does not verify values.
Save, export and inspect fonts, pagination, table widths and captions in Word or WPS.
下载文件应保留需要的章节和可读表图。切换版式与修改正文是不同操作，最终以导出文件为准。
The downloaded document should retain required sections and readable tables and figures. Layout changes and content edits are separate; verify the exported file.
复杂 Office 对象、嵌套表格或多节模板可能无法完整支持。保留原件并检查具体错误，不要默认未识别内容已导入。网页不提供等同 Word 的分页预览。

Complex Office objects, nested tables and multi-section templates may not be fully supported. Keep originals and inspect specific errors rather than assuming unsupported content was imported. The web editor is not a Word pagination preview.
feedback-learning
反馈与下一次报告
Feedback and reuse
让具体修订成为可检查、可回退的经验。
Turn specific revisions into inspectable, reversible experience.
指出需要保留的写法或修改原因，尽量明确适用条件，而不只留下一个分数。
在设置的反馈与学习中决定是否开启自动学习，并设置最多尝试轮数 K；每轮可能增加模型耗时和用量。
查看 Wiki 中整理的经验与候选技能。Wiki 是方法经验，不是当期事实来源。
查看验证结果和采用状态；有候选文件不等于已经启用，任务运行也不等于产生收益。
若采用结果不合适，使用当前版本提供的回退入口并确认有效技能状态；保留原始反馈与比较记录。
Explain the desired writing behavior or reason for a correction, including when it applies, rather than leaving only a score.
Choose whether to enable automatic learning in settings and set the maximum rounds K. Additional rounds can increase model usage and time.
Inspect Wiki experience and proposed skills. The Wiki holds method knowledge, not current-period evidence.
Inspect validation results and adoption status. A candidate file does not mean it is active, and a running task does not demonstrate a benefit.
If adoption is unsuitable, use the rollback control available in your version and confirm the active skill state. Preserve original feedback and comparison records.
应能分清原始反馈、候选、验证结果和当前采用内容。反馈可整理成经验，比较后再决定是否采用；不保证每轮分数提高。
You should be able to distinguish feedback, candidates, validation and active content. Feedback can become experience evaluated for adoption; scores are not guaranteed to improve every round.
暂停或额度不足时保留记录，按页面提示恢复。明确的人类要求与评分器自动建议的优先级策略有版本差异；不要把开发中策略当作旧安装包已经支持。

When paused or out of quota, keep records and follow recovery instructions. Policies for explicit human requirements versus automated scoring suggestions vary by version; do not assume a development policy exists in an older installer.
faq-data
常见问题与数据说明
FAQ and data
知道如何保稿、停止任务及管理材料外发。
Preserve drafts, stop tasks and understand data transfers.
工作区与记录保存在本地。使用云端模型时，任务、材料、稿件或反馈中的相关内容会发送给所选服务。
搜索词发送给搜索服务，网页请求到达目标网站；MCP 参数与必要认证发送给所配置的连接器。本地 stdio 程序也可能联网。
关闭公开检索不等于停止向模型发送内容，也不等于每个宿主的网络隔离。自定义网关或代理同样可能接收请求。
任务需停止时使用应用提供的停止入口，等待状态结束。关闭浏览器不停止独立后台服务；桌面退出按保存和任务处理提示操作。
备份时在任务空闲后复制整个工作区。分享日志、审计包或目录前检查材料与个人信息，不要包含凭据。
Workspaces and records are stored locally. Cloud-model use sends relevant task, source, draft or feedback content to the selected service.
Search queries go to the search provider and web requests to target sites. MCP parameters and necessary credentials go to the configured connector; local stdio programs may also access the network.
Disabling public search does not stop model data transfers or guarantee network isolation for every runtime. Custom gateways and proxies may receive requests too.
Use the app’s stop control and wait for a terminal state. Closing a browser does not stop an independent service; follow desktop save and task prompts when exiting.
Back up the entire workspace while tasks are idle. Check materials and personal information before sharing logs, audit packages or folders, and exclude credentials.
失败后已保存的稿件与材料应仍可查看。删除本地副本不会删除第三方已收到的内容，第三方留存规则由服务与账户配置决定。

Saved drafts and sources should remain accessible after failure. Deleting local copies does not delete data already received by third parties; their retention rules depend on the service and account configuration.
HTTP 403、下载失败或依赖失败应按具体阶段排查，不要反复卸载并删除工作区。优先记录版本和错误，使用官方发行页及宿主诊断；公开求助前删去凭据和敏感材料。

Diagnose HTTP 403, download and dependency errors by stage rather than repeatedly uninstalling and deleting workspaces. Record the version and error, use official releases and runtime diagnostics, and remove credentials and sensitive content before public support requests.
